summary: The donor PID 1 chain (libmini, stage0, init, child from references/hakios @ 87bf4851...) builds with the project's own clang 17 and cctools ld as three static arm64 Mach-O executables (LC_UNIXTHREAD, no LC_LOAD_DYLIB or LC_LOAD_DYLINKER, compiled without a diagnostic), and the donor's mkapfs.py makes the small root image root.apfs (4 MiB, byte-for-byte reproducible: same SHA-256 on two runs) in two variants: rc.darwin (Darwin programs, no jobs) and rc.launchd with 22 stock job plists including com.apple.backboardd and com.apple.SpringBoard. Deviations from the donor build.sh, all in the compiler driver: xnu-clang -> the project's clang 17 with --target=arm64-apple-ios16.5, -nostdinc and the project's clang builtin headers, -fno-pic -fno-pie; ld64 via the clang driver -> aarch64-apple-darwin-ld with -arch arm64 -static -e _start -pagezero_size 0x100000000 -iphoneos_version_min 16.5. Reason: neither xnu-clang nor ld64 exists on this host. The donor's other build steps (hello_dyn, injection libraries, Metal, Mesa) are not part of this image.

The job plists are copies of the donor's selection from the owner's IPSW, adjusted by mkjobs.py; no Apple file is committed.
